LESSON: RATES OF REACTIONS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: GENERAL SCIENCE
Strand: Matter and Chemical Reactions
Topic 2.5: Rates of Reactions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 13

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Rates of Reactions, part of Matter and Chemical Reactions in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 GENERAL SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: when carrying out activities to investigate rates of reactions, How do various factors affect the rate of reactions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Rates of Reactions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: as the learner discusses with peers the factors that affect the rate of chemical

reactions.

● Digital literacy: as the learner uses digital devices with assistive technology and print media in appropriate colour

contrast and font to research on the importance of optimum conditions in biological, chemical and physical processes.

Values:
● Responsibility: as the learner carefully uses digital devices with assistive technology to search for information on the

importance of optimum conditions in industrial processes.

● Respect: as the learner respects each other’s opinion while discussing with peers in a group the importance of efficient

industrial processes.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety and security: as the learner observes safety measures when carrying out activities to investigate rates of reactions.

Suggested Learning Resources:

• Posters,

• Digital devices with assistive technology such as screen readers and screen magnifiers,

• Print textbooks in appropriate font and colour,

• Braille textbooks,

47

• Print and tactile braille version of the periodic table.

Key Skills.

● Ability to perform experiments involving the rate of chemical reactions.

● Ability to explain factors that influence the rate of reactions in biological, chemical and physical processes.
